title: What training would help your research?
text: Data Science Services at IQSS runs free workshops, consultations, and guides for researchers at Harvard and MIT. Tell us what you would come to, and we will plan next year’s sessions around the answers.Nine questions, about two minutes. Only the first three are required, and your email is optional.1What is your role?RequiredFacultyPostdoc or research scientistDoctoral studentMaster’s studentUndergraduateResearch or administrative staff2Which school are you in?RequiredChoose oneFaculty of Arts and SciencesSchool of Engineering and Applied SciencesBusiness SchoolChan School of Public HealthDivinity SchoolGraduate School of DesignGraduate School of EducationKennedy SchoolLaw SchoolMedical School or School of Dental MedicineRadcliffe InstituteOther Harvard unitMITElsewhereDepartment or program3How much code do you write for your research?RequiredNone. I use point-and-click tools or none at all.Occasionally, often by adapting someone else’s code.Most weeks.Most days. It is a main part of my work.4Which of these do you use?Choose all that apply.RPythonStataSPSS, SAS, or other statistics softwareAn AI coding assistant or agentNone yet5Which topics would you most like training in?Choose up to three.Getting startedProgramming basicsin R, Python, or StataData cleaning and visualizationIntroductory statisticsResearch workflowReproducible researchGit, project organization, environmentsCollecting dataweb scraping, APIsUsing AI agents in researchwhat they can do, checking their work, responsible useAI tools and sensitive dataprivacy, data retention, IRB and DUA complianceMethods: intermediate and advancedRegression and statistical modelingGLMs, multilevel and longitudinal modelsCausal inferenceexperiments, difference-in-differences, IV, matching and weightingBayesian analysisStudy design and power analysisincluding power by simulationMachine learning and text as data6Which of these would you attend?Choose all that apply.A 60–90 minute talk or demonstrationyou watch and ask questionsA 90 minute workshopyou follow along on your own laptopA 3 hour hands-on workshopwith exercises you work throughA series of 2–4 sessions over a few weeksDrop-in office hoursbring your own problemA self-paced written guideShort recorded videos7How would you prefer to attend a live session?In personOnline, on ZoomEither is fineI would mostly watch the recording later8Anything else you would like us to know?9Would you like to hear from us?Tell me when sessions on my topics are scheduledMy lab, group, or department would like a session run for usI would like a consultation on a project of my ownYour emailOnly if you ticked a box above.Website SubmitThank youThank you. We will use your answers to plan next year’s training. If you asked us to get in touch, we will write to you at the address you gave.
